name: CubeStrike
summary: CubeStrike is a fast-paced arena shooter built natively for iPhone. Guide a customizable cube through dynamically directed waves, evade specialized enemies with perfectly timed dashes, and unleash the Core Lance when the arena closes in. Collect and evolve over 30 power-ups, combine them into build-defining synergies, and face nine bosses whose attack patterns transform across three phases. Endless Mode, a standardized Daily Competition, Boss Rush, and a dedicated Training Arena offer distinct ways to master the game.
